lessons: A settled page costs one sweep, not one day. The US legs read as closes because us_close ran before the pack was built; the label the pack carries for a provisional bar is only needed on the nights it does not.
A mark is a row, not a session. Two collector slots each wrote one, and a Saturday wrote one; a count that reads sixteen for nine sessions is counting the collector's schedule.
A finding about the machine is recorded on the paper page even when it changes no weight. The verdict that could not see Tenaga's cause is what the ramp-week pages will be reading every night.
